visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A metallic stand mixer bowl is shown in an extreme close-up. Inside, thick chocolate-colored dough is being kneaded by a hook attachment, while large chunks of yellow butter are added to the mix. A pink silicone spatula occasionally scrapes the side of the bowl. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a home kitchen setting. (2) The camera angle shifts slightly as chopped walnuts are poured from a silver foil packet into the rotating mixing bowl containing the dark brown dough. The scene is static, focusing on the texture of the ingredients as they begin to incorporate under the pressure of the mixer hook against the stainless steel bowl. (3) The scene cuts to a medium full shot of a woman in a well-lit modern kitchen. She is wearing a striped beige and brown sweater. She works on a white marble countertop with a digital scale and a calculator nearby. She is seen dividing the large mass of chocolate dough into smaller portions using a white plastic dough scraper. (4) A close-up shows the woman's hands flattening a piece of dough with a white rolling pin. She places three small squares of branded dark chocolate on the flattened dough and then rolls it into a cylinder. Several other shaped rolls are visible on the marble surface in the background. (5) The woman holds up a small black rectangular baking pan containing three shaped dough rolls toward the camera, smiling warmly. Later, she wears oven mitts to handle the hot pans. The scene transitions to her hands pulling apart a freshly baked, soft, dark brown loaf of bread to reveal the steamy, porous interior with embedded walnuts. (6) The final shot is a close-up of several slices of the chocolate walnut toast arranged neatly on a dark wooden board. The lighting highlights the rich brown color of the crumb and the visible walnut pieces. A cartoon heart sticker appears in the bottom right corner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady, low-frequency hum from an electric mixer. Underneath, a mid-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a bright guitar texture and a steady 4/4 beat starts. A female voice with a friendly, moderate-pitched tone begins speaking clearly, articulating each syllable with a professional narrative quality. (2) A sharp, crinkling sound of silver foil is heard as walnuts are poured, followed by several short, percussive thuds as the nuts hit the dough inside the metallic bowl. The BGM maintains a consistent volume and upbeat energy. The narrator’s voice remains calm but enthusiastic, with natural rising intonations. (3) The ambient noise floor transitions to a clean Indoor/RoomTone as the mechanical mixer sound fades out. The female narrator continues her story, her speech rate remaining moderate and clear. The acoustic guitar in the BGM provides a rhythmic bed with light percussion and simple harmonic changes. (4) Frequent, short percussive clicks and thuds occur as the dough scraper hits the marble counter and a scale is adjusted. The narrator describes her children's preferences. The BGM’s harmonic tension is low, providing a pleasant, non-distracting accompaniment to the vocal track. (5) A distinct metallic clink is heard as baking pans are moved. Later, a very soft, airy squishing sound occurs as the bread is pulled apart, indicating its soft texture. The BGM swells slightly toward the end. The narrator's voice rises in valence, sounding more joyful as she describes the final sense of happiness.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share a personal home baking recipe for chocolate walnut toast, specifically highlighting the use of premium Godiva chocolate to elevate the simple snack into a 'luxurious' family treat. It uses a warm, relatable narrative about the creator's children and their positive reactions to build an emotional connection and encourage viewers to try the recipe.
